svg.title: Direct 2-D coefficient masks
svg.desc: Numerator masks are outer products: vertical vector × horizontal vector; divide final coefficients by 64

g.text: Numerator masks are outer products: vertical vector × horizontal vector; divide final coefficients by 64
Positive weights: green tint · Negative weights: red tint · Zero: gray. One mask is applied to each 5×5 window.
ARCH 2 uses the global input frame; ARCH 4 applies exactly the same masks to a local patch.
The 64 nonzero products per quartet are nominal terms, not 64 inferred DSP blocks.
